The '''Geonosian north warehouse''' was located in the [[Northern Windfarm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was used by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] to manufacture [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Havoc Squad]] investigated the warehouse after a series of bombings in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]].<ref name="Interception" />
